title: Migrate LLM consumers to SDK boundary

context.summary: Route current and placeholder model consumers through @mindory/llm instead of reading provider config directly in worker/API code.
context.background: TASK-53 introduced the @mindory/llm SDK and new MINDORY_LLM_* namespace. Worker document processors still adapt OCR, ASR, vision, face and embedding role state directly from config, which weakens the SDK boundary required by the installer/model runtime plan.

in: Add @mindory/llm helpers for role-state snapshots used by processors.
Build LLM runtime once for document processing and pass role state from the SDK registry.
Keep text embedding provider creation behind @mindory/llm.
Strengthen validators to reject direct provider package imports and direct placeholder role config reads outside @mindory/llm.
Update docs to describe the consumer boundary.

acceptance_criteria: Worker document pipeline gets ASR/OCR/vision/face role state from @mindory/llm helpers.
API and worker text embeddings are still constructed through @mindory/llm.
No app or processor outside packages/llm imports provider packages directly.
Validators cover the SDK consumer boundary.
Docs explain that consumers use @mindory/llm role snapshots rather than direct provider config reads.
No database schema changes are included.

manual_checks: Confirm direct provider imports remain only inside packages/llm.

risks: The processor interfaces still use local ModelCapabilityState names; TASK-54 should route their values through the SDK without unrelated extractor refactors.
Existing deterministic multimodal fixture behavior must remain unchanged.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
